task_completion.description: The agent has created a WordPress post with the correct title and imported the content from the draft.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A WordPress editor screen showing the title 'Renewable Energy Deployment and Technologies' and body text corresponding to the article draft.

task_completion.visual_evidence: In the editor or block settings, 'Solar Energy Technologies', 'Wind Power Developments', and 'Energy Storage Solutions' are set as Heading 2. If the HTML/Code view is visible, 'id' attributes or 'HTML anchor' fields in the sidebar are populated for these blocks.

task_completion.description: The placeholder is replaced by a bulleted list of jump links (anchors).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A bulleted list at the top of the post containing links that, when clicked or inspected, point to the internal anchors (e.g., #solar-energy).

task_completion.description: The paragraph starting with 'The transition to 100% renewable energy systems...' is converted to a quote block.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The specific paragraph is visually styled as a Blockquote in the WordPress editor (often indicated by a vertical line or distinct indentation).

task_completion.description: The YouTube URL is embedded at the correct placeholder location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A YouTube video player or a YouTube embed block is visible in the post editor where the '[Embed Video Here...]' placeholder used to be.

task_completion.description: The post is assigned to the 'Educational' category and published.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Categories' sidebar shows 'Educational' checked (and newly created). The post status is shown as 'Published' or a 'Post published' snackbar/notification is visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress web interface rather than purely command-line database injections.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser navigating the WordPress dashboard, clicking buttons, and typing in the editor.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened and read the source file ~/Documents/article_draft.txt.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent opening the text file in a terminal (cat/nano) or a text editor before pasting it into WordPress.

integrity.description: The agent removed the placeholder text rather than just adding content around it.
integrity.visual_evidence: The strings '[Insert Table of Contents Here]' and '[Embed Video Here...]' are no longer visible in the final post preview or editor.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required title is 'Renewable Energy Deployment and Technologies'. The three H2 headings must be 'Solar Energy Technologies', 'Wind Power Developments', and 'Energy Storage Solutions'. The quote block must start with 'The transition to 100% renewable energy systems'. The YouTube URL to be embedded is 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1kUE0BZtTRc'. The category must be exactly 'Educational'.
